name: wanderer
_comment: The protagonist, assembled from modern LPC split-per-animation art so it carries jump/climb/run. Light body + messy brown hair, brown leather armour over teal travelling pants and brown shoes — the same look as before, now across the full 12-pose platformer set. Bodies/armour/hair are recolorable single sheets (colour is the sheet default); pants/shoes are colour-split (teal/brown chosen by path).

layers._recolor_note: messy2 hair ships only the colorless master sheet, drawn in the generator's 'orange' reference ramp; remap it to the 'chestnut' brown ramp to keep the wanderer brown-haired.
